description: 指定避難所一覧(オープンデータ) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 浦安市. 災害対策基本法に基づく指定避難所の指定状況に関する都道府県への通知様式です。. Coverage: 浦安市. The portal files it under the publisher 浦安市. Its tags are 指定避難所. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
